req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the creation of a new player via the POST /players/ endpoint. It includes a positive test case to ensure successful creation, a negative test case to handle duplicate squad numbers, and a boundary test case to check the handling of the minimum valid squad number.

tests.name: test_create_new_player_success
preconditions: The players database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid PlayerRequestModel payload.
expected: Location header points to the new resource
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

new_player = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "New Team",
    "league": "New League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/players/squadnumber/27'

tests.name: test_create_new_player_duplicate_squad_number
preconditions: The players database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a PlayerRequestModel payload that has a duplicate squad number.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

duplicate_player = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1991-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Existing Team",
    "league": "Existing League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=duplicate_player)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert response.json()['detail'] == 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
